inlines.v: HYPOCRIT'IC HYPOCRIT'ICAL, adjective Simulating; counterfeiting a religions character; assuming a false and deceitful appearance; applied to persons. 1. Dissembling; concealing one's real character or motives. 2. Proceeding from hypocrisy, or marking hypocrisy; as a hypocritical face or look.
